articles.summary: Ooma, Inc. (NYSE: OOMA), a smart communications platform for businesses and consumers, today announced the Ooma POTS Retirement Resource Hub, a long-term industry education initiative to help organizations identify hidden Plain Old Telephone Service (POTS) dependencies and prepare for the accelerating retirement of legacy copper telephone lines.
articles.title: Ooma Launches POTS Retirement Resource Hub to Help Organizations Navigate the Transition From Legacy Copper Infrastructure
